notes.title: Share your thoughts on the Ploko demo!
notes.notes:
Hello Ploko Builders!

It’s been a little while since we released the Ploko demo, and we just want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has played 💛 

We’d love to hear more about your experience! Your feedback will help us polish the game and make [b]Ploko[/b] as cozy and delightful as possible before launch.

📝 [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScV7nXKXvYVXhVaKXgenfenRpO5Jz3HG4e9NJ7Ga94r_TuGZg/viewform]Take a few minutes to fill out our demo survey here![/url]

And if you haven’t yet, don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam to stay up to date with all the latest news!

Thanks again for your support—we can’t wait to show you what’s next! 🌿📸✨

notes.title: Ploko @ Steam Next Fest 2025!
notes.notes:
Sup everyone,

We are very proud and excited to announce that [b]Ploko [/b]is participating in the [b]Steam Next Fest 2025[/b]! 
The demo is ready and available, give it a try and please [u]wishlist the game[/u], it would help our small team tremendously.

[b]Cheers, Meow,[/b]
